page.title: Storage
page.subtitle: Where your sorted cards are kept, box by box, in the order they went in.
page.emptyDescription: When you empty a bin from the scanner's Bin Levels, or when a full bin pauses scanning, pick or create a location to record where its cards went.
page.deleteDescription: The cards stay in your collections, but they lose this location and their position in it.

emptyDialog.title: Empty bin {{bin}}
emptyDialog.description: Pick where you're putting this bin's cards. Each card is recorded there in the order it was scanned, so you can find it later.
emptyDialog.allFullDescription: Every bin is full, so scanning is paused. Take the cards out of bin {{bin}} and pick where they're going. Each card is recorded there in the order it was scanned.
emptyDialog.lockedDescription: This resets bin {{bin}}'s fill counter to zero. Make sure you've taken the cards out first.

cards.emptyDescription: Cards show up here once a bin is emptied into this location.

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}} from {{location}}?
removeDialog.description: Use this when you've taken the card out, for example because you sold it or put it in a deck. It stays in your collection, and its position in the box is left empty.

search.limited: Showing the first {{count}} cards. Search for more of the name to narrow it down.

upgrade.businessOnly: Storage locations are part of the Business plan.
upgrade.locked: Record which box every card goes into, and where in it, when you empty a bin.
upgrade.lockedWithLocations: You can still browse, search and edit your locations, but recording new cards into them needs Business.

review.nothingLeft: Nothing left to review. Every card here has already been reviewed.
review.startTitle: Go through the cards in this location that haven't been reviewed yet, in box order

emptyAllDialog.title: Empty all bins
emptyAllDialog.description_one: Mark every bin as emptied. Pick where the {{count}} card went so you can find it later.
emptyAllDialog.description_other: Mark every bin as emptied. Pick where the {{count}} cards went so you can find them later.
emptyAllDialog.perBin: Choose a location for each bin
